BiblicalUsage: Joed is named once, in Nehemiah 11:7. In Nehemiah 11:7 we read, "And these are the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah..."
TheologicalSignificance: Joed belongs in the record, and my position is that the small names matter as much as the great ones.
